dataset: NASA LRO LOLA South Pole DEM (LDEM_80S_20M / 5M)

sites.name: Haworth
sites.notes: High-elevation rim terrain adjacent to Haworth crater's permanently shadowed cold traps; moderate regional slopes with steeper crater-wall gradients nearby.

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.notes: Prominent highland massif rising ~5,000 m above surrounding floor; strong Earth line-of-sight with steeper flank gradients.

sites.name: Nobile Rim 1
sites.notes: Raised northwestern rim structure surrounding Nobile crater; accessible volatile-bearing PSRs within rover traverse range.

sites.name: Nobile Rim 2
sites.notes: High-standing eastern rim terrain adjacent to Nobile crater; favorable local slopes across candidate landing patches.

sites.name: de Gerlache Rim 2
sites.notes: High-illumination ridge on the southern crest of de Gerlache crater; close to permanently shadowed cold traps.

sites.name: Slater Plain
sites.notes: Highland plain southeast of Shackleton crater; characterized by lower relative slopes suitable for lander touchdown.

sites.name: Peak near Cabeus B
sites.notes: Northernmost Artemis III polar candidate region; elevated relief with favorable solar and communication visibility.

sites.name: Mons Mouton Plateau
sites.notes: Expansive high-standing plateau (formerly Leibnitz Beta Plateau); broad, relatively flat exploration zone.

sites.name: Mons Mouton
sites.notes: Massive upland mountain massif adjacent to Mons Mouton Plateau; prominent topographic crest with long illumination windows.
